title: Load a recorded screenshot
responsibility: Loads the selected runtime screenshot for the shown project and commit, reports its loading state, and releases the image when the view is finished.

inputs.name: recordedPreview.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace providing the project, selected revision and authorized screenshot reader.

inputs.name: recordedPreview.entityId
inputs.description: Registered entity whose recorded screenshot is requested.

inputs.name: recordedPreview.thumbnail
inputs.description: Selected screenshot metadata, including its revision and media identity.

inputs.name: recordedPreview.apply
inputs.description: Receives loading, loaded or unavailable preview state until cleanup releases the image.

outputs.name: stop
outputs.description: A cleanup function to call when the preview is replaced or removed. It ignores late results and releases any image URL already created; it does not cancel the underlying request.
